strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.title: 掘地见母
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.subtitle: 郑伯克段
strings.vo.01: 郑武公娶于申，曰武姜，生庄公及共叔段。庄公寤生，惊姜氏，故名寤生，遂恶之。
strings.vo.02: 庄公即位，姜氏为段请京。祭仲说：都城过百雉，国之害也。
strings.vo.03: 庄公说：多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。
strings.vo.04: 段缮甲兵，将袭郑，夫人将启之。庄公命子封帅车二百乘伐京。
strings.vo.05: 平乱之后，庄公对母亲立誓——
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.quote: 多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.fork.prompt: 掘地见母——依《左传》直书，还是听演义《东周列国志》？
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.pick.canon: 正史 · 《左传·隐公元年》所载
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.canon.intro: 祭仲、子封一再催促，庄公只说“将自及”。他等的是一个让谁都无话可说的时机。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.end.canon: 公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.legend.disclaimer: 以下按明清演义小说《东周列国志》第四回改编，大体依《左传》，截获密书、颍考叔献鸮等细节为小说增饰。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.legend.intro: 演义写：姜氏密约段于四月下旬袭郑，公子吕在路上截住送信之人，庄公拆信看罢，重新封好，另遣人送去。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.end.legend: 演义同样以隧中相见作结，只是让庄公先“将计就计”，再让颍考叔借鸟说话。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhengbo.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若庄公早听祭仲（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 鲁隐公元年，郑庄公二十二年（前 722 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 722 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

characters.name: 共叔段
characters.zh: 共叔段（郑·京城大叔）：深衣、皮弁；宗室贵胄华服，玉佩冠带；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；姜氏所爱，居京，缮甲兵欲袭郑，败而出奔共

characters.name: 公子吕
characters.zh: 公子吕（郑·子封）：深衣、皮弁，犀皮甲，青铜剑，乘战车；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；帅车二百乘伐京
characters.en: Gongzi Lü (公子吕) — general, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps, rhinoceros-hide armour, bronze swords, war chariots; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.en: Zheng Zhuanggong (郑庄公) — ruler, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 郑武公娶于申，曰武姜，生庄公及共叔段。庄公寤生，惊姜氏，故名寤生，遂恶之。

shots.vo: 庄公说：多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。

shots.vo: 段缮甲兵，将袭郑，夫人将启之。庄公命子封帅车二百乘伐京。

shots.vo: 平乱之后，庄公对母亲立誓——

shots.en: Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 誓; dry-brush calligraphy 「黄泉之誓」 | Action: Not until the Yellow Springs shall we meet again | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: thud of earth | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「平乱之后，庄公对母亲立誓——」

shots.vo: 公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（36–46 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (36–46 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: In the tunnel mother and son recite verses of joy and are reconciled as before. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。」

shots.vo: 多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（46–52 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」，下署《左传·隐公元年》；右下角朱印「黄泉之誓」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (46–52 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」 signed 《左传·隐公元年》; vermilion seal 「黄泉之誓」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、军营鼓声、远处厮杀声、战后余风；音效：竹简翻动、远处鼓声、马蹄声、号角、夯土闷响；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, camp drums, distant battle, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, distant drums, hoofbeats, horn, thud of earth; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「掘地见母」、副题「郑伯克段」、朱印「黄泉之誓」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」——《左传·隐公元年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

narration: 郑武公娶于申，曰武姜，生庄公及共叔段。庄公寤生，惊姜氏，故名寤生，遂恶之。
庄公即位，姜氏为段请京。祭仲说：都城过百雉，国之害也。
庄公说：多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。
段缮甲兵，将袭郑，夫人将启之。庄公命子封帅车二百乘伐京。
平乱之后，庄公对母亲立誓——
公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。
多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】春秋 · 掘地见母（郑伯克段）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 52 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：春秋 · 鲁隐公元年，郑庄公二十二年（前 722 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。

- 公子吕（郑·子封）：深衣、皮弁，犀皮甲，青铜剑，乘战车；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；帅车二百乘伐京

镜头 3（16–22 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：共叔段、军阵、长兵如林、长枪｜动作：京城大叔缮甲兵，具卒乘｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：远处鼓声｜屏幕文字：引文「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「庄公说：多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」
镜头 4（22–30 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：公子吕、骑兵、旌旗｜动作：子封帅车二百乘，京人叛段｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：马蹄声、号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「段缮甲兵，将袭郑，夫人将启之。庄公命子封帅车二百乘伐京。」
镜头 5（30–36 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：誓；飞白题字「黄泉之誓」｜动作：不及黄泉，无相见也｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：夯土闷响｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「平乱之后，庄公对母亲立誓——」
镜头 6（36–46 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。」
镜头 7（46–52 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」，下署《左传·隐公元年》；右下角朱印「黄泉之誓」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、军营鼓声、远处厮杀声、战后余风；音效：竹简翻动、远处鼓声、马蹄声、号角、夯土闷响；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「掘地见母」、副题「郑伯克段」、朱印「黄泉之誓」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」——《左传·隐公元年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · Meeting His Mother Underground: Duke Zhuang of Zheng (「掘地见母」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 52 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 722 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Gong Shuduan (共叔段) — royal / consort, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wu Jiang (武姜) — royal / consort, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Ji Zhong (祭仲) — minister, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Gongzi Lü (公子吕) — general, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps, rhinoceros-hide armour, bronze swords, war chariots; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zheng Zhuanggong (郑庄公) — ruler, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Ying Kaoshu (颍考叔) — minister, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, crenellated city wall | Action: The Zheng capital Xinzheng, distant hills beyond the walls | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「掘地见母」 with vermilion seal 「黄泉之誓」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「郑武公娶于申，曰武姜，生庄公及共叔段。庄公寤生，惊姜氏，故名寤生，遂恶之。」
Shot 2 (9–16 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Wu Jiang, Ji Zhong | Action: Lady Jiang asks for Jing for Duan; Zhai Zhong warns the walls are too long | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「庄公即位，姜氏为段请京。祭仲说：都城过百雉，国之害也。」
Shot 3 (16–22 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Gong Shuduan, army ranks, forest of spears, spear | Action: Duan at Jing repairs armour and gathers chariots | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「庄公说：多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」
Shot 4 (22–30 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Gongzi Lü, cavalry, banners | Action: Zifeng leads two hundred chariots and the people of Jing desert Duan | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats, horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「段缮甲兵，将袭郑，夫人将启之。庄公命子封帅车二百乘伐京。」
Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 誓; dry-brush calligraphy 「黄泉之誓」 | Action: Not until the Yellow Springs shall we meet again | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: thud of earth | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「平乱之后，庄公对母亲立誓——」
Shot 6 (36–46 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: In the tunnel mother and son recite verses of joy and are reconciled as before. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「公入而赋：大隧之中，其乐也融融。姜出而赋：大隧之外，其乐也泄泄。遂为母子如初。」
Shot 7 (46–52 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」 signed 《左传·隐公元年》; vermilion seal 「黄泉之誓」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, camp drums, distant battle, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, distant drums, hoofbeats, horn, thud of earth; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「掘地见母」, subtitle 「郑伯克段」 and vermilion seal 「黄泉之誓」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「多行不义，必自毙，子姑待之。」 — 《左传·隐公元年》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.chunqiu.huangong.title: 尊王攘夷
strings.scene.chunqiu.huangong.subtitle: 齐桓称霸
strings.vo.01: 齐襄公被弑，两位公子争先回国：公子纠由鲁，公子小白由莒。
strings.vo.02: 管仲引弓射小白，正中带钩。小白佯死，先入临淄即位，是为齐桓公。
strings.vo.03: 鲍叔牙说：君欲霸王，非管夷吾不可。桓公释射钩之仇，任管仲为相。
strings.vo.04: 齐以“尊王攘夷”号令诸侯，北伐山戎，南责楚国包茅不贡。
strings.scene.chunqiu.huangong.fork.prompt: 尊王攘夷——依《史记》直书，还是听野史「老马识途」？
strings.scene.chunqiu.huangong.canon.intro: 齐襄公死了，两位公子都在往临淄赶。路上有一支箭，在等其中一个人。
strings.scene.chunqiu.huangong.end.canon: 葵丘之盟，诸侯尊齐。桓公成为春秋第一位霸主。
strings.scene.chunqiu.huangong.legend.disclaimer: 以下故事出自《韩非子·说林上》，属于诸子书中的寓言式记载，细节真实性难以核实。
strings.scene.chunqiu.huangong.legend.intro: 齐伐孤竹，春往冬返，迷失道路。管仲说：老马之智可用也。于是放老马在前，大军随之，果然找到归路。
strings.scene.chunqiu.huangong.end.legend: 大军随老马走出山谷。故事讲的是“不耻师于老马”，齐国霸业照旧。

黑白红武侠水墨剪影素材图（人物立绘），题材：尊王攘夷·齐桓称霸（前 685—前 651 年）。
画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 齐桓公（小白）（齐·君主）；2. 管仲（夷吾）（齐·文臣）；3. 鲍叔牙（齐大夫）（齐·文臣）。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 齐桓公元年至三十五年（前 685—前 651 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 685 BCE–651 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

shots.vo: 齐襄公被弑，两位公子争先回国：公子纠由鲁，公子小白由莒。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、草｜动作：临淄城外，旷野长道｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「尊王攘夷」竖排书法与朱印「九合诸侯」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐襄公被弑，两位公子争先回国：公子纠由鲁，公子小白由莒。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, grass | Action: A long road across the plain outside Linzi | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「尊王攘夷」 with vermilion seal 「九合诸侯」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐襄公被弑，两位公子争先回国：公子纠由鲁，公子小白由莒。」

shots.vo: 管仲引弓射小白，正中带钩。小白佯死，先入临淄即位，是为齐桓公。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–16 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：管仲、齐桓公、弓箭｜动作：两位公子争先回国，管仲一箭｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：放箭｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「管仲引弓射小白，正中带钩。小白佯死，先入临淄即位，是为齐桓公。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Guan Zhong, Qi Huangong, bow | Action: Two princes race home; Guan Zhong shoots an arrow | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: arrow release | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「管仲引弓射小白，正中带钩。小白佯死，先入临淄即位，是为齐桓公。」

shots.vo: 鲍叔牙说：君欲霸王，非管夷吾不可。桓公释射钩之仇，任管仲为相。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（16–24 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：鲍叔牙、齐桓公｜动作：鲍叔牙荐管仲，桓公释仇｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「鲍叔牙说：君欲霸王，非管夷吾不可。桓公释射钩之仇，任管仲为相。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (16–24 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Bao Shuya, Qi Huangong | Action: Bao Shuya recommends Guan Zhong and Duke Huan forgives his enemy | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「鲍叔牙说：君欲霸王，非管夷吾不可。桓公释射钩之仇，任管仲为相。」

shots.vo: 齐以“尊王攘夷”号令诸侯，北伐山戎，南责楚国包茅不贡。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（24–31 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：骑兵、旌旗、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：北伐山戎，南责楚贡｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：马蹄声、号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐以“尊王攘夷”号令诸侯，北伐山戎，南责楚国包茅不贡。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (24–31 s, 7 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: cavalry, banners, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: North against the Mountain Rong, south to rebuke Chu | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; ink spatters where hooves strike; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats, horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐以“尊王攘夷”号令诸侯，北伐山戎，南责楚国包茅不贡。」

shots.vo: 葵丘之会，周天子赐胙——

narration: 齐襄公被弑，两位公子争先回国：公子纠由鲁，公子小白由莒。
管仲引弓射小白，正中带钩。小白佯死，先入临淄即位，是为齐桓公。
鲍叔牙说：君欲霸王，非管夷吾不可。桓公释射钩之仇，任管仲为相。
齐以“尊王攘夷”号令诸侯，北伐山戎，南责楚国包茅不贡。
葵丘之会，周天子赐胙——
葵丘之盟，诸侯尊齐。桓公成为春秋第一位霸主。

【水墨视频生成提示词】春秋 · 尊王攘夷（齐桓称霸）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 50 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：春秋 · 齐桓公元年至三十五年（前 685—前 651 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · Honour the King, Repel the Barbarians: Duke Huan of Qi (「尊王攘夷」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 50 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 685 BCE–651 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Qi Huangong (齐桓公) — ruler, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Guan Zhong (管仲) — minister, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

- Xi Peng (隰朋) — minister, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.title: 一鼓作气
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.subtitle: 长勺之战
strings.vo.01: 齐师伐鲁。鲁庄公将战，曹刿请见。
strings.vo.02: 他问：何以战？公说衣食不敢专，牺牲不敢加。曹刿都说不够。
strings.vo.03: 公说：小大之狱，虽不能察，必以情。曹刿说：可以一战。
strings.vo.04: 战于长勺。公将鼓之，曹刿说：未可。
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.quote: 夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.fork.prompt: 一鼓作气——依《左传》直书，还是听异说「曹刿还是曹沫」？
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.pick.canon: 正史 · 《左传·庄公十年》所载
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.canon.intro: 乡人说，肉食者会谋划的，你掺和什么？曹刿说：肉食者鄙，未能远谋。
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.end.canon: 齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.pick.legend: 异说 · 曹刿还是曹沫
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.legend.disclaime: 以下是史料之间的分歧：《左传》的曹刿与《史记》的曹沫是否一人，古今有不同看法；出土的上博简《曹沫之陈》也加入了讨论。
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.legend.intro: 《史记·刺客列传》说：曹沫为鲁将，与齐战，三败北；柯之盟上，他执匕首劫齐桓公，迫其归还侵地。
strings.scene.chunqiu.changshao.end.legend: 桓公归鲁侵地，管仲劝他守信。不论曹刿、曹沫是否一人，柯之盟都与史书相合。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 鲁庄公十年（前 684 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 684 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

characters.name: 曹刿
characters.zh: 曹刿（鲁·鲁人）：深衣、皮弁；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；“肉食者鄙，未能远谋”，请见庄公，论战于长勺
characters.en: Cao Gui (曹刿) — scholar, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 鲁庄公
characters.zh: 鲁庄公（鲁·姬同）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与曹刿同乘，战于长勺
characters.en: Lu Zhuanggong (鲁庄公) — ruler, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 齐桓公
characters.zh: 齐桓公（齐·小白）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；即位次年伐鲁
characters.en: Qi Huangong (齐桓公) — ruler, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 乡人
characters.zh: 乡人（鲁·曹刿之乡人）：深衣、皮弁；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；“肉食者谋之，又何间焉”
characters.en: Xiang Ren (乡人) — commoner, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 曹沫
characters.zh: 曹沫（鲁·鲁将（《史记·刺客列传》））：深衣、皮弁，犀皮甲，青铜剑，乘战车；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；柯之盟以匕首劫桓公；或以为即曹刿
characters.en: Cao Mo (曹沫) — general, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps, rhinoceros-hide armour, bronze swords, war chariots; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 齐师伐鲁。鲁庄公将战，曹刿请见。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、草｜动作：长勺原野，两军相望｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「一鼓作气」竖排书法与朱印「一鼓作气」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐师伐鲁。鲁庄公将战，曹刿请见。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, grass | Action: The field of Changshao, two armies facing each other | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「一鼓作气」 with vermilion seal 「一鼓作气」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐师伐鲁。鲁庄公将战，曹刿请见。」

shots.vo: 他问：何以战？公说衣食不敢专，牺牲不敢加。曹刿都说不够。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（6–14 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：曹刿、鲁庄公｜动作：曹刿入见：何以战？｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他问：何以战？公说衣食不敢专，牺牲不敢加。曹刿都说不够。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (6–14 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Gui, Lu Zhuanggong | Action: Cao Gui asks: on what will you fight? | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他问：何以战？公说衣食不敢专，牺牲不敢加。曹刿都说不够。」

shots.vo: 公说：小大之狱，虽不能察，必以情。曹刿说：可以一战。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（14–21 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：齐桓公、军阵、长兵如林、旌旗｜动作：齐人一鼓，鲁军不动｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：远处鼓声｜屏幕文字：引文「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「公说：小大之狱，虽不能察，必以情。曹刿说：可以一战。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (14–21 s, 7 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Qi Huangong, army ranks, forest of spears, banners | Action: Qi drums once; Lu does not move | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「公说：小大之狱，虽不能察，必以情。曹刿说：可以一战。」

shots.vo: 战于长勺。公将鼓之，曹刿说：未可。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（21–27 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：曹刿、旌旗｜动作：齐人三鼓，曹刿曰：可矣｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：急鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「战于长勺。公将鼓之，曹刿说：未可。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (21–27 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Cao Gui, banners | Action: Qi drums a third time; Cao Gui says: now | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「战于长勺。公将鼓之，曹刿说：未可。」

shots.vo: 齐人三鼓——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（27–33 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：骑兵；飞白题字「一鼓作气」｜动作：视其辙乱，望其旗靡｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；四角暗角收拢；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：急鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐人三鼓——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (27–33 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「一鼓作气」 | Action: He sees their tracks confused and banners drooping | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; ink spatters where hooves strike; vignette closing in from the corners; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐人三鼓——」

shots.vo: 齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（33–42 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (33–42 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The Qi army breaks and is pursued; three years later Cao Mo seizes Duke Huan with a dagger at Ke and land is returned. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。」

shots.vo: 夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（42–48 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」，下署《左传·庄公十年》；右下角朱印「一鼓作气」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (42–48 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」 signed 《左传·庄公十年》; vermilion seal 「一鼓作气」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、军营鼓声、远处厮杀声；音效：竹简翻动、远处鼓声、急鼓；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, camp drums, distant battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, distant drums, drum burst; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「一鼓作气」、副题「长勺之战」、朱印「一鼓作气」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」——《左传·庄公十年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差
onScreenText.en: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「一鼓作气」, subtitle 「长勺之战」 and vermilion seal 「一鼓作气」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」 — 《左传·庄公十年》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

narration: 齐师伐鲁。鲁庄公将战，曹刿请见。
他问：何以战？公说衣食不敢专，牺牲不敢加。曹刿都说不够。
公说：小大之狱，虽不能察，必以情。曹刿说：可以一战。
战于长勺。公将鼓之，曹刿说：未可。
齐人三鼓——
齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。
夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】春秋 · 一鼓作气（长勺之战）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 48 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：春秋 · 鲁庄公十年（前 684 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。

人物：
- 曹刿（鲁·鲁人）：深衣、皮弁；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；“肉食者鄙，未能远谋”，请见庄公，论战于长勺
- 鲁庄公（鲁·姬同）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；与曹刿同乘，战于长勺
- 齐桓公（齐·小白）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；即位次年伐鲁
- 乡人（鲁·曹刿之乡人）：深衣、皮弁；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；“肉食者谋之，又何间焉”
- 曹沫（鲁·鲁将（《史记·刺客列传》））：深衣、皮弁，犀皮甲，青铜剑，乘战车；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；柯之盟以匕首劫桓公；或以为即曹刿

分镜：
镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、草｜动作：长勺原野，两军相望｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「一鼓作气」竖排书法与朱印「一鼓作气」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐师伐鲁。鲁庄公将战，曹刿请见。」
镜头 2（6–14 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：曹刿、鲁庄公｜动作：曹刿入见：何以战？｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他问：何以战？公说衣食不敢专，牺牲不敢加。曹刿都说不够。」
镜头 3（14–21 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：齐桓公、军阵、长兵如林、旌旗｜动作：齐人一鼓，鲁军不动｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：远处鼓声｜屏幕文字：引文「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「公说：小大之狱，虽不能察，必以情。曹刿说：可以一战。」
镜头 4（21–27 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：曹刿、旌旗｜动作：齐人三鼓，曹刿曰：可矣｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：急鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「战于长勺。公将鼓之，曹刿说：未可。」
镜头 5（27–33 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：骑兵；飞白题字「一鼓作气」｜动作：视其辙乱，望其旗靡｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；四角暗角收拢；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：急鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐人三鼓——」
镜头 6（33–42 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。」
镜头 7（42–48 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」，下署《左传·庄公十年》；右下角朱印「一鼓作气」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」

声音：背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、军营鼓声、远处厮杀声；音效：竹简翻动、远处鼓声、急鼓；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「一鼓作气」、副题「长勺之战」、朱印「一鼓作气」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」——《左传·庄公十年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · One Drum Roll of Courage: the Battle of Changshao (「一鼓作气」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 48 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 684 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Cao Gui (曹刿) — scholar, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Lu Zhuanggong (鲁庄公) — ruler, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Qi Huangong (齐桓公) — ruler, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xiang Ren (乡人) — commoner, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Cao Mo (曹沫) — general, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps, rhinoceros-hide armour, bronze swords, war chariots; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, grass | Action: The field of Changshao, two armies facing each other | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「一鼓作气」 with vermilion seal 「一鼓作气」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐师伐鲁。鲁庄公将战，曹刿请见。」
Shot 2 (6–14 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Gui, Lu Zhuanggong | Action: Cao Gui asks: on what will you fight? | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他问：何以战？公说衣食不敢专，牺牲不敢加。曹刿都说不够。」
Shot 3 (14–21 s, 7 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Qi Huangong, army ranks, forest of spears, banners | Action: Qi drums once; Lu does not move | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「公说：小大之狱，虽不能察，必以情。曹刿说：可以一战。」
Shot 4 (21–27 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Cao Gui, banners | Action: Qi drums a third time; Cao Gui says: now | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「战于长勺。公将鼓之，曹刿说：未可。」
Shot 5 (27–33 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「一鼓作气」 | Action: He sees their tracks confused and banners drooping | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; ink spatters where hooves strike; vignette closing in from the corners; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐人三鼓——」
Shot 6 (33–42 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The Qi army breaks and is pursued; three years later Cao Mo seizes Duke Huan with a dagger at Ke and land is returned. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐师败绩，遂逐之。三年后，齐鲁会盟于柯，鲁将曹沫执匕首劫桓公，齐归鲁侵地。」
Shot 7 (42–48 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」 signed 《左传·庄公十年》; vermilion seal 「一鼓作气」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」

Sound: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, camp drums, distant battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, distant drums, drum burst; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「一鼓作气」, subtitle 「长勺之战」 and vermilion seal 「一鼓作气」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。」 — 《左传·庄公十年》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.title: 五羖大夫
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.subtitle: 百里奚
strings.vo.01: 前 655 年，晋国灭虞，虞国大夫百里奚被当作陪嫁之臣送往秦国。半路他逃到楚国的宛邑，被当地人捉去放牛。
strings.vo.02: 秦穆公听说他贤能，怕重金去赎反而引起楚人警觉，只派人带着五张黑色公羊皮，说是赎回一个逃亡的奴隶。
strings.vo.03: 百里奚这年已经七十多岁。穆公亲自为他松绑，要和他谈国事；他推辞说自己是亡国之臣，不值得问。
strings.vo.04: 穆公不听，与他一连谈了三天三夜，大喜过望，要把国政交给他。
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.quote: 缪公闻百里傒贤，欲重赎之，恐楚人不与，乃使人谓楚曰：“吾媵臣百里傒在焉，请以五羖羊皮赎之。”
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.fork.prompt: 五羖大夫——依《史记》直书，还是听演义《东周列国志》？
strings.anchor.luyu: 晋灭虞，百里奚为媵臣入秦，亡走宛
strings.anchor.shouzheng: 秦穆公授百里奚国政，号五羖大夫
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.canon.intro: 一个七十岁的逃奴，价钱是五张羊皮。秦国称霸西戎的路，从这桩买卖开始。
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.end.canon: 穆公授百里奚国政，号为五羖大夫；百里奚又荐蹇叔，穆公以厚币迎为上大夫。秦从此任用东方客卿，渐霸西戎。
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取冯梦龙、蔡元放《东周列国志》第二十六回“歌扊扅百里认妻”的敷演：秦宫浣衣的老妇唱出旧歌，百里奚认出失散多年的妻子。此事见于汉代以后的民间歌谣，史书不载。
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.legend.intro: 演义里，相府堂下有个洗衣的老妇，请求抚琴唱一支歌。
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.end.legend: 相府里夫妻重逢，穆公赐以厚礼。演义添了一段团圆，五羖大夫的故事仍按史书收尾。
strings.scene.chunqiu.baolixi.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若楚人识破（未开放）

cast.name: 秦穆公
cast.title: 秦君
cast.bio: 闻其贤，以五羖羊皮赎之，与语三日

cast.name: 蹇叔
cast.title: 百里奚之友
cast.bio: 百里奚荐之于穆公，迎为上大夫

cast.bio: 演义中于秦宫浣衣，歌扊扅之曲认夫

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 秦穆公五年（前 655 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。

shots.vo: 前 655 年，晋国灭虞，虞国大夫百里奚被当作陪嫁之臣送往秦国。半路他逃到楚国的宛邑，被当地人捉去放牛。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：草；主体：百里奚｜动作：楚国宛邑的郊野，一个白发老人赶着牛走在田埂上｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：低风；音效：牛群｜屏幕文字：片名「五羖大夫」竖排书法与朱印「五羖」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 655 年，晋国灭虞，虞国大夫百里奚被当作陪嫁之臣送往秦国。半路他逃到楚国的宛邑，被当地人捉去放牛。」

shots.vo: 秦穆公听说他贤能，怕重金去赎反而引起楚人警觉，只派人带着五张黑色公羊皮，说是赎回一个逃亡的奴隶。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（12–24 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；主体：百里奚、众人｜动作：秦国的使者手捧五张黑色的羊皮，对楚人说要赎回逃奴｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秦穆公听说他贤能，怕重金去赎反而引起楚人警觉，只派人带着五张黑色公羊皮，说是赎回一个逃亡的奴隶。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (12–24 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: Baili Xi, crowd | Action: A Qin envoy holds up five black ram skins and tells the Chu men he has come to ransom a runaway slave | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦穆公听说他贤能，怕重金去赎反而引起楚人警觉，只派人带着五张黑色公羊皮，说是赎回一个逃亡的奴隶。」

shots.vo: 百里奚这年已经七十多岁。穆公亲自为他松绑，要和他谈国事；他推辞说自己是亡国之臣，不值得问。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（24–35 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：秦穆公、百里奚｜动作：雍城宫中，秦穆公亲自解开老人的绳索｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：绳索｜屏幕文字：引文「缪公闻百里傒贤，欲重赎之，恐楚人不与，乃使人谓楚曰：“吾媵臣百里傒在焉，请以五羖羊皮赎之。”」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「百里奚这年已经七十多岁。穆公亲自为他松绑，要和他谈国事；他推辞说自己是亡国之臣，不值得问。」

shots.vo: 穆公不听，与他一连谈了三天三夜，大喜过望，要把国政交给他。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（35–43 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：秦穆公、百里奚｜动作：君臣对坐，烛火燃了三天三夜，竹简在案上越堆越高｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：琴室；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「穆公不听，与他一连谈了三天三夜，大喜过望，要把国政交给他。」

narration: 前 655 年，晋国灭虞，虞国大夫百里奚被当作陪嫁之臣送往秦国。半路他逃到楚国的宛邑，被当地人捉去放牛。
秦穆公听说他贤能，怕重金去赎反而引起楚人警觉，只派人带着五张黑色公羊皮，说是赎回一个逃亡的奴隶。
百里奚这年已经七十多岁。穆公亲自为他松绑，要和他谈国事；他推辞说自己是亡国之臣，不值得问。
穆公不听，与他一连谈了三天三夜，大喜过望，要把国政交给他。
老人却起身说——
穆公授百里奚国政，号为五羖大夫；百里奚又荐蹇叔，穆公以厚币迎为上大夫。秦从此任用东方客卿，渐霸西戎。
缪公闻百里傒贤，欲重赎之，恐楚人不与，乃使人谓楚曰：“吾媵臣百里傒在焉，请以五羖羊皮赎之。”

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · Five Ram Skins: Baili Xi (「五羖大夫」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 67 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 655 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Baili Xi (百里奚) — minister, Yu; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; elderly; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Qin Mugong (秦穆公) — ruler, Qin; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Jian Shu (蹇叔) — scholar, Song; shenyi robes and leather caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Du Shi (杜氏) — commoner, Yu; shenyi robes and leather caps; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass; subject: Baili Xi | Action: On the outskirts of Wan in Chu, a white-haired old man drives an ox along a field ridge | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: cattle | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「五羖大夫」 with vermilion seal 「五羖」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 655 年，晋国灭虞，虞国大夫百里奚被当作陪嫁之臣送往秦国。半路他逃到楚国的宛邑，被当地人捉去放牛。」
Shot 2 (12–24 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: Baili Xi, crowd | Action: A Qin envoy holds up five black ram skins and tells the Chu men he has come to ransom a runaway slave | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秦穆公听说他贤能，怕重金去赎反而引起楚人警觉，只派人带着五张黑色公羊皮，说是赎回一个逃亡的奴隶。」
Shot 3 (24–35 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Qin Mugong, Baili Xi | Action: In the palace at Yong, Duke Mu of Qin unties the old man's ropes himself | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: rope | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「缪公闻百里傒贤，欲重赎之，恐楚人不与，乃使人谓楚曰：“吾媵臣百里傒在焉，请以五羖羊皮赎之。”」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「百里奚这年已经七十多岁。穆公亲自为他松绑，要和他谈国事；他推辞说自己是亡国之臣，不值得问。」
Shot 4 (35–43 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Qin Mugong, Baili Xi | Action: Ruler and minister sit facing each other for three days and nights as the bamboo slips pile up | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: guqin room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「穆公不听，与他一连谈了三天三夜，大喜过望，要把国政交给他。」
Shot 5 (43–49 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Baili Xi; dry-brush calligraphy 「五羖」 | Action: The old man rises and bows: "I am not the equal of my friend Jian Shu." | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: cattle | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「老人却起身说——」
Shot 6 (49–61 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Baili Xi | Action: Canonical outcome: Duke Mu gives Baili Xi the government of Qin and calls him the Minister of Five Ram Skins; on his advice Jian Shu is brought in as a senior minister, and Qin begins its rise over the Western Rong. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「穆公授百里奚国政，号为五羖大夫；百里奚又荐蹇叔，穆公以厚币迎为上大夫。秦从此任用东方客卿，渐霸西戎。」
Shot 7 (61–67 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「缪公闻百里傒贤，欲重赎之，恐楚人不与，乃使人谓楚曰：“吾媵臣百里傒在焉，请以五羖羊皮赎之。”」 signed 《史记·秦本纪》; vermilion seal 「五羖」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「缪公闻百里傒贤，欲重赎之，恐楚人不与，乃使人谓楚曰：“吾媵臣百里傒在焉，请以五羖羊皮赎之。”」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: low wind, crowd murmur, palace hall reverb, guqin room tone, quiet room tone; SFX: cattle, footsteps, rope, bamboo slips rustling; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「五羖大夫」, subtitle 「百里奚」 and vermilion seal 「五羖」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「缪公闻百里傒贤，欲重赎之，恐楚人不与，乃使人谓楚曰：“吾媵臣百里傒在焉，请以五羖羊皮赎之。”」 — 《史记·秦本纪》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.title: 泓水之战
strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.subtitle: 宋襄公之仁
strings.vo.01: 前 638 年冬，宋襄公伐郑，楚国出兵救郑。两军在泓水相遇，宋军先到，已经列好了阵。
strings.vo.02: 楚军开始渡河。宋国的司马子鱼看得很清楚：楚人多，宋人少，这是唯一的机会。
strings.vo.03: 子鱼请求趁楚军半渡出击：他们人多，我们人少，趁他们还没渡完，请击之。宋襄公不许。
strings.vo.04: 楚军渡完了，还没排好阵，子鱼又请，襄公还是说不可。
strings.vo.05: 等楚军阵形整齐，宋公才下令击鼓。楚军一冲，宋军大败，襄公的卫士几乎全部战死，一支箭射中了他的大腿——
strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.quote: 君子不重伤，不禽二毛。古之为军也，不以阻隘也。
strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.fork.prompt: 泓水之战——依《左传》直书，还是听演义《东周列国志》？
strings.anchor.zhuchu: 楚人伐宋以救郑，宋襄公迎战
strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.canon.intro: 泓水边的宋襄公，被后世一半人笑作迂腐，一半人敬作最后的贵族。
strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.end.canon: 宋师大败，襄公伤股，次年夏因伤而卒。子鱼说：“君未知战。”宋国争霸的梦从此结束，而“不鼓不成列”成了一句千古争论的话。
strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.legend.disclaimer: 以下取冯梦龙、蔡元放《东周列国志》第三十四回“宋襄公假仁失众”的敷演：小说中宋襄公阵前高举“仁义”大旗，被楚军夺去。“仁义之旗”是小说家的添笔，史书只记其言。
strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.legend.intro: 演义里，宋襄公的车上竖着一面大旗，上书两个大字：仁义。
strings.scene.chunqiu.hongshui.end.legend: 演义让“仁义”二字落进了楚人手里，讽刺的意思比史书重。宋师之败与襄公之伤，两边记载相同。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 鲁僖公二十二年（前 638 年冬十一月）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 638 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

characters.name: 宋襄公
characters.zh: 宋襄公（宋·宋君兹甫）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；“君子不重伤，不禽二毛”，不击未济之楚师
characters.en: Song Xianggong (宋襄公) — ruler, Song; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 目夷
characters.zh: 目夷（宋·宋司马子鱼，襄公庶兄）：深衣、皮弁；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；两次请击楚军未济、未成列，皆不许
characters.en: Mu Yi (目夷) — minister, Song; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 成得臣
characters.zh: 成得臣（楚·楚将子玉）：深衣、皮弁，犀皮甲，青铜剑，乘战车；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；率楚师渡泓水
characters.en: Cheng Dechen (成得臣) — general, Chu; shenyi robes and leather caps, rhinoceros-hide armour, bronze swords, war chariots; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 前 638 年冬，宋襄公伐郑，楚国出兵救郑。两军在泓水相遇，宋军先到，已经列好了阵。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：河水；主体：宋襄公、军阵、旌旗、长兵如林｜动作：泓水北岸，宋军列阵已毕，旗帜在冬风里绷直｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：旗倒｜屏幕文字：片名「泓水之战」竖排书法与朱印「不鼓不成列」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 638 年冬，宋襄公伐郑，楚国出兵救郑。两军在泓水相遇，宋军先到，已经列好了阵。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: river; subject: Song Xianggong, army ranks, banners, forest of spears | Action: On the north bank of the Hong the Song army has formed up, banners taut in the winter wind | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: falling banner | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「泓水之战」 with vermilion seal 「不鼓不成列」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 638 年冬，宋襄公伐郑，楚国出兵救郑。两军在泓水相遇，宋军先到，已经列好了阵。」

shots.vo: 楚军开始渡河。宋国的司马子鱼看得很清楚：楚人多，宋人少，这是唯一的机会。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–19 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：河水；主体：成得臣、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：对岸楚军开始涉水，河心里人马拥挤｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：滴水；音效：水花｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「楚军开始渡河。宋国的司马子鱼看得很清楚：楚人多，宋人少，这是唯一的机会。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–19 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river; subject: Cheng Dechen, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Across the river the Chu army begins to wade over, men and horses crowding mid-stream | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: dripping water; SFX: water splash | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「楚军开始渡河。宋国的司马子鱼看得很清楚：楚人多，宋人少，这是唯一的机会。」

shots.vo: 子鱼请求趁楚军半渡出击：他们人多，我们人少，趁他们还没渡完，请击之。宋襄公不许。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（19–29 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：河水；主体：目夷、宋襄公｜动作：司马子鱼策马到车前：彼众我寡，趁他们没渡完，请击之｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：低风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：引文「君子不重伤，不禽二毛。古之为军也，不以阻隘也。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「子鱼请求趁楚军半渡出击：他们人多，我们人少，趁他们还没渡完，请击之。宋襄公不许。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (19–29 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river; subject: Mu Yi, Song Xianggong | Action: Marshal Ziyu rides up to the chariot: they are many, we are few, strike before they finish crossing | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「君子不重伤，不禽二毛。古之为军也，不以阻隘也。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「子鱼请求趁楚军半渡出击：他们人多，我们人少，趁他们还没渡完，请击之。宋襄公不许。」

shots.vo: 楚军渡完了，还没排好阵，子鱼又请，襄公还是说不可。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（29–36 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：主体：宋襄公、目夷、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：楚军上岸，阵还没列好，子鱼再请；襄公仍摇头｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「楚军渡完了，还没排好阵，子鱼又请，襄公还是说不可。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (29–36 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: subject: Song Xianggong, Mu Yi, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Chu lands but has not yet formed ranks; Ziyu begs again, and the duke still shakes his head | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「楚军渡完了，还没排好阵，子鱼又请，襄公还是说不可。」

shots.vo: 等楚军阵形整齐，宋公才下令击鼓。楚军一冲，宋军大败，襄公的卫士几乎全部战死，一支箭射中了他的大腿——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（36–48 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：宋襄公、军阵、长兵如林、长枪；飞白题字「不鼓不成列」｜动作：楚阵已成，鼓声大作，宋军被冲散，一支箭射中襄公的大腿｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；四角暗角收拢；兵刃金属寒光一闪；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「等楚军阵形整齐，宋公才下令击鼓。楚军一冲，宋军大败，襄公的卫士几乎全部战死，一支箭射中了他的大腿——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (36–48 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: Song Xianggong, army ranks, forest of spears, spear; dry-brush calligraphy 「不鼓不成列」 | Action: Chu's line is formed, drums thunder, the Song ranks break and an arrow strikes the duke in the thigh | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; vignette closing in from the corners; a cold metallic glint on the blade; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「等楚军阵形整齐，宋公才下令击鼓。楚军一冲，宋军大败，襄公的卫士几乎全部战死，一支箭射中了他的大腿——」

shots.vo: 宋师大败，襄公伤股，次年夏因伤而卒。子鱼说：“君未知战。”宋国争霸的梦从此结束，而“不鼓不成列”成了一句千古争论的话。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（48–61 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：宋襄公｜动作：正史结局：宋师大败，襄公伤股，次年夏因伤而卒。子鱼说：“君未知战。”宋国争霸的梦从此结束，而“不鼓不成列”成了一句千古争论的话。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「宋师大败，襄公伤股，次年夏因伤而卒。子鱼说：“君未知战。”宋国争霸的梦从此结束，而“不鼓不成列”成了一句千古争论的话。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (48–61 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Song Xianggong | Action: Canonical outcome: Song is routed and the duke wounded; he dies of the wound the next summer. "No drums before the enemy is in ranks" becomes a line argued over for two thousand years. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宋师大败，襄公伤股，次年夏因伤而卒。子鱼说：“君未知战。”宋国争霸的梦从此结束，而“不鼓不成列”成了一句千古争论的话。」

narration: 前 638 年冬，宋襄公伐郑，楚国出兵救郑。两军在泓水相遇，宋军先到，已经列好了阵。
楚军开始渡河。宋国的司马子鱼看得很清楚：楚人多，宋人少，这是唯一的机会。
子鱼请求趁楚军半渡出击：他们人多，我们人少，趁他们还没渡完，请击之。宋襄公不许。
楚军渡完了，还没排好阵，子鱼又请，襄公还是说不可。
等楚军阵形整齐，宋公才下令击鼓。楚军一冲，宋军大败，襄公的卫士几乎全部战死，一支箭射中了他的大腿——
宋师大败，襄公伤股，次年夏因伤而卒。子鱼说：“君未知战。”宋国争霸的梦从此结束，而“不鼓不成列”成了一句千古争论的话。
君子不重伤，不禽二毛。古之为军也，不以阻隘也。

[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · The Battle of the Hong River: Duke Xiang's Benevolence (「泓水之战」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 67 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 638 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.title: 绵上之火
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.subtitle: 介子推
strings.vo.01: 前 636 年，流亡十九年的重耳回到晋国即位，是为晋文公。跟着他流亡的人，个个都来请赏。
strings.vo.02: 只有介之推不提俸禄。他说：献公九个儿子只剩国君一人，这是天意。别人把天的功劳算作自己的，这是偷。
strings.vo.03: 母亲问他：你不去说，也让国君知道一下，怎么样？他回答：言语是身体的文饰，身体都要隐去了，还要文饰做什么？
strings.vo.04: 母亲说：那我和你一起走。母子二人就此隐居，到死也没有出来。
strings.vo.05: 文公派人到处寻找，找不到。他站在绵上的山下——
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.quote: 窃人之财，犹谓之盗，况贪天之功以为己力乎？
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.fork.prompt: 绵上之火——依《左传》直书，还是听演义《东周列国志》？
strings.anchor.buyanlu: 晋文公赏从亡者，介之推不言禄
strings.anchor.mianshangtian: 以绵上为之田，“以志吾过”
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.canon.intro: 晋文公的赏赐名单上少了一个人。他没有被忘记，是他自己走了。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.end.canon: 文公求之不获，以绵上为介推之田，说：“以志吾过，且旌善人。”《左传》《史记》都只写到这里，没有焚山的事。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.legend.disclaimer: 以下取冯梦龙、蔡元放《东周列国志》第三十七回“介子推守志焚绵上”的敷演：文公放火烧山想逼他出来，介子推抱树而死，后世寒食禁火由此而来。焚山之说始见于汉代以后的记载，史书不载。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.legend.intro: 演义里，有人献计：三面放火，留一面出路，他一定会背着母亲出来。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiezitui.end.legend: 演义里火灭之后，人们在一棵烧焦的柳树下找到母子二人。文公下令每年这一天禁火寒食。史书里的介之推只是隐去，没有被烧死。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 晋文公元年（前 636 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 636 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

characters.name: 介之推
characters.zh: 介之推（晋·从晋文公流亡十九年之臣）：深衣、皮弁；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；不言禄，与母偕隐
characters.en: Jie Zhitui (介之推) — minister, Jin; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 晋文公
characters.zh: 晋文公（晋·重耳，归国即位）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；求之不获，以绵上为之田
characters.en: Jin Wengong (晋文公) — ruler, Jin; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 介母
characters.zh: 介母（晋·介之推之母）：深衣、皮弁；女子衣着，依身份；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；问子：“亦使知之，若何？”
characters.en: Jie Mu (介母) — commoner, Jin; shenyi robes and leather caps; female dress appropriate to rank; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 前 636 年，流亡十九年的重耳回到晋国即位，是为晋文公。跟着他流亡的人，个个都来请赏。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–11 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、关门；主体：众人｜动作：绛都宫门外，从亡的功臣排队领赏，车马络绎｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：车轮｜屏幕文字：片名「绵上之火」竖排书法与朱印「绵上」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 636 年，流亡十九年的重耳回到晋国即位，是为晋文公。跟着他流亡的人，个个都来请赏。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, gate; subject: crowd | Action: Outside the palace gate at Jiang, the companions of exile queue for rewards amid carts and horses | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: cart wheels | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「绵上之火」 with vermilion seal 「绵上」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 636 年，流亡十九年的重耳回到晋国即位，是为晋文公。跟着他流亡的人，个个都来请赏。」

shots.vo: 只有介之推不提俸禄。他说：献公九个儿子只剩国君一人，这是天意。别人把天的功劳算作自己的，这是偷。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（11–23 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；主体：介之推｜动作：一个瘦削的中年人站在人群外，转身离开｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓｜声音：环境：低风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「只有介之推不提俸禄。他说：献公九个儿子只剩国君一人，这是天意。别人把天的功劳算作自己的，这是偷。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (11–23 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: Jie Zhitui | Action: A gaunt middle-aged man stands apart from the crowd, turns and walks away | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「只有介之推不提俸禄。他说：献公九个儿子只剩国君一人，这是天意。别人把天的功劳算作自己的，这是偷。」

shots.vo: 母亲问他：你不去说，也让国君知道一下，怎么样？他回答：言语是身体的文饰，身体都要隐去了，还要文饰做什么？
shots.zh: 镜头 3（23–35 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：介母、介之推｜动作：茅屋里，老母问他：你也该去说一声｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：咳嗽｜屏幕文字：引文「窃人之财，犹谓之盗，况贪天之功以为己力乎？」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「母亲问他：你不去说，也让国君知道一下，怎么样？他回答：言语是身体的文饰，身体都要隐去了，还要文饰做什么？」
shots.en: Shot 3 (23–35 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Jie Mu, Jie Zhitui | Action: In a thatched hut his old mother asks: shouldn't you at least tell him? | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: cough | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「窃人之财，犹谓之盗，况贪天之功以为己力乎？」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「母亲问他：你不去说，也让国君知道一下，怎么样？他回答：言语是身体的文饰，身体都要隐去了，还要文饰做什么？」

shots.vo: 母亲说：那我和你一起走。母子二人就此隐居，到死也没有出来。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（35–43 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：近山与地面、树、树冠；主体：介之推、介母｜动作：母子背着一点粮食，走进绵上的深山｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：林中鸟鸣；音效：树叶沙沙｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「母亲说：那我和你一起走。母子二人就此隐居，到死也没有出来。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (35–43 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground, trees, tree canopy; subject: Jie Zhitui, Jie Mu | Action: Mother and son shoulder a little grain and walk into the deep hills of Mianshang | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: forest birds; SFX: rustling leaves | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「母亲说：那我和你一起走。母子二人就此隐居，到死也没有出来。」

shots.vo: 文公派人到处寻找，找不到。他站在绵上的山下——
