narration: 前 542 年，郑国人常在乡校里聚会，议论执政的好坏。大夫然明担心生事，请子产把乡校毁掉。
子产说：人们早晚闲暇在这里议论，他们说好的我就做，说坏的我就改，这是我的老师，为什么要毁掉？
他又说：我只听说用忠善减少怨恨，没听说靠威势防止怨恨。堵住人们的嘴，就像筑堤防川，决口了伤人更多。
前 536 年三月，子产把刑法条文铸在鼎上，公布给国人。这是中国历史上较早的成文法公布之一。
晋国的叔向写信来反对，说百姓知道了法条，就会据法相争。子产回信——
子产回信说：“侨不才，不能及子孙，吾以救世也。”二十多年后，晋国也铸了刑鼎。孔子听说子产不毁乡校，说：人谓子产不仁，吾不信也。
吾闻忠善以损怨，不闻作威以防怨。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

镜头 6（54–68 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：子产、叔向｜动作：正史结局：子产回信说：“侨不才，不能及子孙，吾以救世也。”二十多年后，晋国也铸了刑鼎。孔子听说子产不毁乡校，说：人谓子产不仁，吾不信也。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「子产回信说：“侨不才，不能及子孙，吾以救世也。”二十多年后，晋国也铸了刑鼎。孔子听说子产不毁乡校，说：人谓子产不仁，吾不信也。」
镜头 7（68–74 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「吾闻忠善以损怨，不闻作威以防怨。」，下署《左传·襄公三十一年》；右下角朱印「铸刑书」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「吾闻忠善以损怨，不闻作威以防怨。」

声音：背景乐：编钟，庄严典雅，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：人群低语、寂静室内、琴室、火声、低风；音效：低语、脚步声、衣袂摩挲、锤击；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「铸刑书」、副题「子产相郑」、朱印「铸刑书」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「吾闻忠善以损怨，不闻作威以防怨。」——《左传·襄公三十一年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · Casting the Penal Code: Zichan of Zheng (「铸刑书」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 74 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 536 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Zi Chan (子产) — minister, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Ran Ming (然明) — minister, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Shu Xiang (叔向) — minister, Jin; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xiao Ren (校人) — commoner, Zheng; shenyi robes and leather caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, 书写; subject: crowd | Action: In the village school of the Zheng capital, gentlemen gather to debate the government's merits | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「铸刑书」 with vermilion seal 「铸刑书」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 542 年，郑国人常在乡校里聚会，议论执政的好坏。大夫然明担心生事，请子产把乡校毁掉。」
Shot 2 (11–22 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Ran Ming, Zi Chan | Action: Minister Ranming advises: better to tear the school down | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「子产说：人们早晚闲暇在这里议论，他们说好的我就做，说坏的我就改，这是我的老师，为什么要毁掉？」
Shot 3 (22–34 s, 12 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zi Chan | Action: Zichan waves the idea away: these people are my teachers | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: guqin room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「吾闻忠善以损怨，不闻作威以防怨。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他又说：我只听说用忠善减少怨恨，没听说靠威势防止怨恨。堵住人们的嘴，就像筑堤防川，决口了伤人更多。」
Shot 4 (34–45 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: 书写; subject: Zi Chan, fire (splashed ink) | Action: Six years later, founders pour the text of the laws into a great bronze cauldron | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: hammer strike | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 536 年三月，子产把刑法条文铸在鼎上，公布给国人。这是中国历史上较早的成文法公布之一。」
Shot 5 (45–54 s, 9 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: scroll; subject: Zi Chan, Shu Xiang; dry-brush calligraphy 「刑书」 | Action: A letter arrives from Jin; Shuxiang writes that once people know the laws they will no longer fear their betters | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: hammer strike | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「晋国的叔向写信来反对，说百姓知道了法条，就会据法相争。子产回信——」
Shot 6 (54–68 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Zi Chan, Shu Xiang | Action: Canonical outcome: Zichan replies that he cannot provide for future generations, he is only trying to save his own age. Twenty years later Jin casts its own law cauldron. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「子产回信说：“侨不才，不能及子孙，吾以救世也。”二十多年后，晋国也铸了刑鼎。孔子听说子产不毁乡校，说：人谓子产不仁，吾不信也。」
Shot 7 (68–74 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「吾闻忠善以损怨，不闻作威以防怨。」 signed 《左传·襄公三十一年》; vermilion seal 「铸刑书」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「吾闻忠善以损怨，不闻作威以防怨。」

Sound: Music: bianzhong bronze bells, stately and ceremonial, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: crowd murmur, quiet room tone, guqin room tone, fire, low wind; SFX: murmuring, footsteps, rustling silk, hammer strike; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「铸刑书」, subtitle 「子产相郑」 and vermilion seal 「铸刑书」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「吾闻忠善以损怨，不闻作威以防怨。」 — 《左传·襄公三十一年》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.title: 昭关
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.subtitle: 伍子胥
strings.vo.01: 楚平王听费无忌之谗，囚太子建之傅伍奢，又召他的两个儿子。
strings.vo.02: 兄长伍尚知道是死，仍然去了。弟弟伍员贯弓执矢，向使者，使者不敢进。
strings.vo.03: 伍员奔宋、奔郑，又往吴去。到了昭关，关吏要捉他。
strings.vo.04: 他与太子建之子胜徒步逃走，追者在后。江上有一渔父，渡他过江。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.quote: 楚国之法，得伍胥者赐粟五万石，爵执珪，岂徒百金剑邪！
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.fork.prompt: 昭关——依《史记》直书，还是听野史「一夜白头」？
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.pick.canon: 正史 · 《史记·伍子胥列传》所载
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.canon.intro: 史书只写了一句“几不得脱”。昭关之下，伍员与公子胜徒步而行，追兵就在身后。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.end.canon: 吴兵入郢，楚昭王出奔。伍子胥掘楚平王之墓，出其尸，鞭之三百（《史记》载，《左传》不载）。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.legend.disclaimer: 以下按民间传说与明清演义小说《东周列国志》第七十二回改编：东皋公、皇甫讷与一夜白头，都不见于《史记》。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.legend.intro: 演义说：昭关盘查甚严。隐士东皋公把伍员藏在家中，伍员忧急一夜，次日须发尽白，连自己都认不出。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhaoguan.end.legend: 过了昭关，仍要渡江、入吴。传说接回史书，十六年后同归入郢。

黑白红武侠水墨剪影素材图（人物立绘），题材：昭关·伍子胥（前 522—前 506 年）。
画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×3 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 伍子胥（伍员）（楚→吴·文臣）；2. 楚平王（熊居）（楚·君主）；3. 伍奢（太子建之傅）（楚·文臣）。
第 2 行：4. 伍尚（伍奢长子）（楚·其他）；5. 吴王阖闾（公子光）（吴·君主）；6. 孙武（吴将）（吴·武将）。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 楚平王七年至吴王阖闾九年（前 522—前 506 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。

shots.vo: 楚平王听费无忌之谗，囚太子建之傅伍奢，又召他的两个儿子。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山、山石剪影；中景：关门｜动作：楚地山川，关隘在两山之间｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：高处疾风｜屏幕文字：片名「昭关」竖排书法与朱印「过昭关」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「楚平王听费无忌之谗，囚太子建之傅伍奢，又召他的两个儿子。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: gate | Action: Chu hills and a pass between two mountains | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: high wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「昭关」 with vermilion seal 「过昭关」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「楚平王听费无忌之谗，囚太子建之傅伍奢，又召他的两个儿子。」

shots.vo: 兄长伍尚知道是死，仍然去了。弟弟伍员贯弓执矢，向使者，使者不敢进。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–17 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：楚平王、费无忌｜动作：平王听谗，召伍奢二子｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「兄长伍尚知道是死，仍然去了。弟弟伍员贯弓执矢，向使者，使者不敢进。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Chu Pingwang, Fei Wuji | Action: King Ping believes slander and summons Wu She's two sons | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「兄长伍尚知道是死，仍然去了。弟弟伍员贯弓执矢，向使者，使者不敢进。」

shots.vo: 伍员奔宋、奔郑，又往吴去。到了昭关，关吏要捉他。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（17–24 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：伍尚、伍子胥、弓箭｜动作：伍尚赴死，伍员张弓不就｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：弓弦｜屏幕文字：引文「楚国之法，得伍胥者赐粟五万石，爵执珪，岂徒百金剑邪！」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「伍员奔宋、奔郑，又往吴去。到了昭关，关吏要捉他。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (17–24 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Wu Shang, Wu Zixu, bow | Action: Wu Shang goes to his death; Wu Yuan draws his bow and refuses | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bowstring | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「楚国之法，得伍胥者赐粟五万石，爵执珪，岂徒百金剑邪！」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「伍员奔宋、奔郑，又往吴去。到了昭关，关吏要捉他。」

shots.vo: 他与太子建之子胜徒步逃走，追者在后。江上有一渔父，渡他过江。

narration: 楚平王听费无忌之谗，囚太子建之傅伍奢，又召他的两个儿子。
兄长伍尚知道是死，仍然去了。弟弟伍员贯弓执矢，向使者，使者不敢进。
伍员奔宋、奔郑，又往吴去。到了昭关，关吏要捉他。
他与太子建之子胜徒步逃走，追者在后。江上有一渔父，渡他过江。
十六年后——
吴兵入郢，楚昭王出奔。伍子胥掘楚平王之墓，出其尸，鞭之三百（《史记》载，《左传》不载）。
楚国之法，得伍胥者赐粟五万石，爵执珪，岂徒百金剑邪！

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】春秋 · 昭关（伍子胥）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 55 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：春秋 · 楚平王七年至吴王阖闾九年（前 522—前 506 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。

人物：
- 伍子胥（楚→吴·伍员）：深衣、皮弁；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；父兄被杀，奔吴；助阖闾即位，柏举之战入郢
- 楚平王（楚·熊居）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；听费无忌之谗，杀伍奢父子
- 伍尚（楚·伍奢长子）：深衣、皮弁；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；知召而往，与父同死

- 伍奢（楚·太子建之傅）：深衣、皮弁；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；被平王所杀
- 吴王阖闾（吴·公子光）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；用专诸刺王僚自立，任伍子胥、孙武伐楚

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · Zhao Pass: Wu Zixu (「昭关」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 55 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 522 BCE–506 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Wu Zixu (伍子胥) — minister, 楚→吴; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Chu Pingwang (楚平王) — ruler, Chu; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wu Shang (伍尚) — commoner, Chu; shenyi robes and leather caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yu Fu (渔父) — commoner, Chu; shenyi robes and leather caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Fei Wuji (费无忌) — minister, Chu; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wu She (伍奢) — minister, Chu; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wu Wanghelü (吴王阖闾) — ruler, Wu; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sun Wu (孙武) — general, Wu; shenyi robes and leather caps, rhinoceros-hide armour, bronze swords, war chariots; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: gate | Action: Chu hills and a pass between two mountains | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: high wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「昭关」 with vermilion seal 「过昭关」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「楚平王听费无忌之谗，囚太子建之傅伍奢，又召他的两个儿子。」
Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Chu Pingwang, Fei Wuji | Action: King Ping believes slander and summons Wu She's two sons | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「兄长伍尚知道是死，仍然去了。弟弟伍员贯弓执矢，向使者，使者不敢进。」
Shot 3 (17–24 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Wu Shang, Wu Zixu, bow | Action: Wu Shang goes to his death; Wu Yuan draws his bow and refuses | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bowstring | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「楚国之法，得伍胥者赐粟五万石，爵执珪，岂徒百金剑邪！」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「伍员奔宋、奔郑，又往吴去。到了昭关，关吏要捉他。」
Shot 4 (24–32 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: gate, river, boat; subject: Yu Fu | Action: Pursuers behind at Zhao Pass; a fisherman on the river | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他与太子建之子胜徒步逃走，追者在后。江上有一渔父，渡他过江。」
Shot 5 (32–38 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: army ranks, forest of spears; dry-brush calligraphy 「入郢之箭」 | Action: One battle at Boju and the capital Ying falls | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: arrow release | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「十六年后——」
Shot 6 (38–49 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Wu troops enter Ying; Wu Zixu digs up King Ping's corpse and flogs it, as the Shiji records. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「吴兵入郢，楚昭王出奔。伍子胥掘楚平王之墓，出其尸，鞭之三百（《史记》载，《左传》不载）。」
Shot 7 (49–55 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「楚国之法，得伍胥者赐粟五万石，爵执珪，岂徒百金剑邪！」 signed 《史记·伍子胥列传》; vermilion seal 「过昭关」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「楚国之法，得伍胥者赐粟五万石，爵执珪，岂徒百金剑邪！」

Sound: Music: xiao flute, plaintive and long, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: high wind, palace hall reverb, wind over open plains, calm river, distant battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, bowstring, oars, arrow release; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「昭关」, subtitle 「伍子胥」 and vermilion seal 「过昭关」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「楚国之法，得伍胥者赐粟五万石，爵执珪，岂徒百金剑邪！」 — 《史记·伍子胥列传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.title: 鱼腹藏剑
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.subtitle: 专诸刺王僚
strings.vo.01: 前 515 年夏，吴王僚趁楚国国丧出兵伐楚，国内空虚。四月，公子光请王僚赴宴。王僚有防备，从王宫到光的家门，一路站满了他的卫兵。
strings.vo.02: 上菜的人都要在门口脱衣搜查，再由卫士持铍夹送到席前。每一道菜，都要从两排刀锋之间走过。
strings.vo.03: 酒到半酣，公子光说脚疼，起身退入地下室。那里早已埋伏好了甲士。
strings.vo.04: 端菜上来的，是伍子胥多年前荐给他的勇士专诸。专诸说过：母老子弱，王僚可杀。公子光答：我就是你的身体。
strings.vo.05: 炙鱼放到王僚面前，专诸掰开鱼腹——
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.quote: 王僚可杀也。母老子弱，而两公子将兵攻楚，楚绝其后。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.fork.prompt: 鱼腹藏剑——依《左传》直书，还是听演义《东周列国志》？
strings.anchor.fujia: 公子光伏甲于堀室而享吴王僚
strings.anchor.helvli: 专诸刺杀王僚，公子光即位为阖闾
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.canon.intro: 姑苏的一场家宴，从王宫到宴席，一路都是甲士。刺客的剑藏在一条鱼里。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.end.canon: 匕首穿透了王僚的铠甲，左右卫士当场杀死专诸。公子光伏甲尽出，杀王僚之众，自立为王，就是吴王阖闾。阖闾封专诸之子为上卿。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.legend.disclaimer: 以下取冯梦龙、蔡元放《东周列国志》第七十三回“伍员吹箫乞吴市 专诸进炙刺王僚”的敷演：小说写专诸专程去太湖学炙鱼三月，又写他事母至孝、其母为成全他而自缢。这些细节多出于后世敷衍，史书不载。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.legend.intro: 演义里，专诸临行前回家辞母，母亲支开他去打水。
strings.scene.chunqiu.zhuanzhu.end.legend: 演义里专诸之母先自缢，以断其顾念，专诸遂行。宴席上的一击，与史书所记相同。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 吴王僚十二年、鲁昭公二十七年（前 515 年夏四月）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 515 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

characters.name: 专诸
characters.zh: 专诸（吴·堂邑勇士）：深衣、皮弁，犀皮甲，青铜剑，乘战车；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；置匕首鱼腹中进之，刺杀王僚，当场被杀
characters.en: Zhuan Zhu (专诸) — commoner, Wu; shenyi robes and leather caps, rhinoceros-hide armour, bronze swords, war chariots; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 公子光
characters.zh: 公子光（吴·吴公子，后为吴王阖闾）：深衣、皮弁；宗室贵胄华服，玉佩冠带；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；伏甲堀室，宴请王僚
characters.en: Gongzi Guang (公子光) — royal / consort, Wu; shenyi robes and leather caps; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 吴王僚
characters.zh: 吴王僚（吴·吴王）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；陈兵自宫至光之家，仍被刺
characters.en: Wu Wangliao (吴王僚) — ruler, Wu; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 伍子胥
characters.zh: 伍子胥（吴·楚亡臣）：深衣、皮弁；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；荐专诸于公子光
characters.en: Wu Zixu (伍子胥) — minister, Wu; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 前 515 年夏，吴王僚趁楚国国丧出兵伐楚，国内空虚。四月，公子光请王僚赴宴。王僚有防备，从王宫到光的家门，一路站满了他的卫兵。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞；主体：军阵、长兵如林、长枪｜动作：吴都，从王宫到公子光家门，路两边站满王僚的甲士｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：甲片作响｜屏幕文字：片名「鱼腹藏剑」竖排书法与朱印「鱼肠」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「前 515 年夏，吴王僚趁楚国国丧出兵伐楚，国内空虚。四月，公子光请王僚赴宴。王僚有防备，从王宫到光的家门，一路站满了他的卫兵。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall; subject: army ranks, forest of spears, spear | Action: In the Wu capital, King Liao's guards line both sides of the road from the palace to Prince Guang's gate | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: rattling armour | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「鱼腹藏剑」 with vermilion seal 「鱼肠」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「前 515 年夏，吴王僚趁楚国国丧出兵伐楚，国内空虚。四月，公子光请王僚赴宴。王僚有防备，从王宫到光的家门，一路站满了他的卫兵。」

shots.vo: 上菜的人都要在门口脱衣搜查，再由卫士持铍夹送到席前。每一道菜，都要从两排刀锋之间走过。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（14–25 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：吴王僚、长枪｜动作：宴席上，侍者都被搜身，持铍的卫士夹道而立｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：金属撞击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「上菜的人都要在门口脱衣搜查，再由卫士持铍夹送到席前。每一道菜，都要从两排刀锋之间走过。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (14–25 s, 11 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Wu Wangliao, spear | Action: At the banquet every servant is searched, guards with long blades flank the aisle | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: metal clang | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「上菜的人都要在门口脱衣搜查，再由卫士持铍夹送到席前。每一道菜，都要从两排刀锋之间走过。」

shots.vo: 酒到半酣，公子光说脚疼，起身退入地下室。那里早已埋伏好了甲士。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（25–33 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：公子光｜动作：公子光说脚疼，起身离席，走进地下的密室｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：引文「王僚可杀也。母老子弱，而两公子将兵攻楚，楚绝其后。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「酒到半酣，公子光说脚疼，起身退入地下室。那里早已埋伏好了甲士。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (25–33 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Gongzi Guang | Action: Prince Guang complains of a sore foot, leaves the table and slips down into the cellar | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「王僚可杀也。母老子弱，而两公子将兵攻楚，楚绝其后。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「酒到半酣，公子光说脚疼，起身退入地下室。那里早已埋伏好了甲士。」

shots.vo: 端菜上来的，是伍子胥多年前荐给他的勇士专诸。专诸说过：母老子弱，王僚可杀。公子光答：我就是你的身体。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（33–45 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：专诸、吴王僚｜动作：一个厨子捧着一条炙鱼走上堂来，鱼腹微微鼓起｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「端菜上来的，是伍子胥多年前荐给他的勇士专诸。专诸说过：母老子弱，王僚可杀。公子光答：我就是你的身体。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (33–45 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Zhuan Zhu, Wu Wangliao | Action: A cook carries a roast fish up to the hall, its belly slightly swollen | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「端菜上来的，是伍子胥多年前荐给他的勇士专诸。专诸说过：母老子弱，王僚可杀。公子光答：我就是你的身体。」

shots.vo: 炙鱼放到王僚面前，专诸掰开鱼腹——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：专诸、吴王僚、长剑；飞白题字「鱼肠」｜动作：他掰开鱼腹，抽出匕首——｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；兵刃金属寒光一闪；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：刀声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「炙鱼放到王僚面前，专诸掰开鱼腹——」

narration: 前 515 年夏，吴王僚趁楚国国丧出兵伐楚，国内空虚。四月，公子光请王僚赴宴。王僚有防备，从王宫到光的家门，一路站满了他的卫兵。
上菜的人都要在门口脱衣搜查，再由卫士持铍夹送到席前。每一道菜，都要从两排刀锋之间走过。
酒到半酣，公子光说脚疼，起身退入地下室。那里早已埋伏好了甲士。
端菜上来的，是伍子胥多年前荐给他的勇士专诸。专诸说过：母老子弱，王僚可杀。公子光答：我就是你的身体。
炙鱼放到王僚面前，专诸掰开鱼腹——
匕首穿透了王僚的铠甲，左右卫士当场杀死专诸。公子光伏甲尽出，杀王僚之众，自立为王，就是吴王阖闾。阖闾封专诸之子为上卿。
王僚可杀也。母老子弱，而两公子将兵攻楚，楚绝其后。

strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.title: 夹谷之会
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.subtitle: 孔子相礼
strings.vo.01: 鲁定公十年夏，鲁君与齐侯在夹谷会盟。孔子以司寇的身份担任相礼。
strings.vo.02: 齐国大夫犁弥对齐侯说：孔丘懂礼而没有勇气，若让莱人带兵劫持鲁侯，一定能得逞。
strings.vo.03: 会上，莱人持兵涌上坛来。孔子护着鲁君后退，命鲁国的士兵上前。
strings.vo.04: 他说：两国国君和好，却让东夷的俘虏拿着兵器来扰乱，这不是齐君号令诸侯的做法。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.fork.prompt: 夹谷之会——依《左传》直书，还是听异说「斩优倡侏儒」？
strings.anchor.guitian: 齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《左传·定公十年》所载
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.canon.intro: 这是孔子一生中最接近“权力”的一刻。他手里没有兵，只有礼。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.end.canon: 齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《史记·孔子世家》与《穀梁传·定公十年》：会后齐人又使优倡侏儒为戏，孔子以“匹夫而荧惑诸侯者罪当诛”，命有司行法，手足异处。此说《左传》不载，后世学者多疑其不合孔子为人；明清演义小说《东周列国志》第七十八回采此说。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.legend.intro: 莱人退下了。不一会儿，又有一群优倡侏儒，嬉笑着来到鲁君面前。
strings.scene.chunqiu.jiagu.end.legend: 斩与不斩，史书各执一词。齐人归田，是三书都记载的结局。

背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×3 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 远山（淡墨）；2. 近坡（中墨）；3. 土坡地线。
第 2 行：4. 草丛（枯笔）；5. 殿堂内景；6. 立柱。
第 3 行：7. 帷帐；8. 留空；9. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1536 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 鲁定公十年，齐景公四十八年（前 500 年夏）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 500 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

characters.name: 孔丘
characters.zh: 孔丘（鲁·鲁司寇，相礼）：深衣、皮弁；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；以礼却莱人之兵，使齐归侵地
characters.en: Kong Qiu (孔丘) — scholar, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 鲁定公
characters.zh: 鲁定公（鲁·鲁君）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；会齐侯于夹谷
characters.en: Lu Dinggong (鲁定公) — ruler, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 齐景公
characters.zh: 齐景公（齐·齐君）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；欲以莱人劫鲁侯，闻孔子之言而辟之
characters.en: Qi Jinggong (齐景公) — ruler, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 犁弥
characters.zh: 犁弥（齐·齐大夫）：深衣、皮弁；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；献计以莱人劫鲁侯
characters.en: Li Mi (犁弥) — minister, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 鲁定公十年夏，鲁君与齐侯在夹谷会盟。孔子以司寇的身份担任相礼。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：旌旗｜动作：夹谷的山间，两国的坛场相对而设｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「夹谷之会」竖排书法与朱印「夹谷」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「鲁定公十年夏，鲁君与齐侯在夹谷会盟。孔子以司寇的身份担任相礼。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: banners | Action: In the hills of Jiagu two altars face each other | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「夹谷之会」 with vermilion seal 「夹谷」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「鲁定公十年夏，鲁君与齐侯在夹谷会盟。孔子以司寇的身份担任相礼。」

shots.vo: 齐国大夫犁弥对齐侯说：孔丘懂礼而没有勇气，若让莱人带兵劫持鲁侯，一定能得逞。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（9–19 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：孔丘、鲁定公、旌旗｜动作：孔子立在鲁君身侧，整了整衣冠｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐国大夫犁弥对齐侯说：孔丘懂礼而没有勇气，若让莱人带兵劫持鲁侯，一定能得逞。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (9–19 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Kong Qiu, Lu Dinggong, banners | Action: Confucius stands beside the Duke of Lu and straightens his robes | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐国大夫犁弥对齐侯说：孔丘懂礼而没有勇气，若让莱人带兵劫持鲁侯，一定能得逞。」

shots.vo: 会上，莱人持兵涌上坛来。孔子护着鲁君后退，命鲁国的士兵上前。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（19–27 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：犁弥、众人、长枪｜动作：鼓声里，一群莱人持兵冲上坛来｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：引文「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「会上，莱人持兵涌上坛来。孔子护着鲁君后退，命鲁国的士兵上前。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (19–27 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Li Mi, crowd, spear | Action: To the drums, Lai men rush the altar with weapons | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「会上，莱人持兵涌上坛来。孔子护着鲁君后退，命鲁国的士兵上前。」

shots.vo: 他说：两国国君和好，却让东夷的俘虏拿着兵器来扰乱，这不是齐君号令诸侯的做法。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（27–37 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：孔丘；飞白题字「裔不谋夏」｜动作：孔子护着鲁君后退，厉声呵斥｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他说：两国国君和好，却让东夷的俘虏拿着兵器来扰乱，这不是齐君号令诸侯的做法。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (27–37 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Kong Qiu; dry-brush calligraphy 「裔不谋夏」 | Action: Confucius shields the duke and rebukes them sternly | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他说：两国国君和好，却让东夷的俘虏拿着兵器来扰乱，这不是齐君号令诸侯的做法。」

shots.vo: 齐侯听了——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（37–43 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：地图卷、归田；主体：齐景公｜动作：齐国归还了郓、讙、龟阴之田｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐侯听了——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (37–43 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: map scroll, 归田; subject: Qi Jinggong | Action: Qi returns the lands of Yun, Huan and Guiyin | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐侯听了——」

shots.vo: 齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（43–52 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：齐景公｜动作：正史结局：齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (43–52 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Qi Jinggong | Action: Canonical outcome: The Qi ruler backs down; an armed ambush is defused by Confucius through ritual alone. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。」

shots.vo: 裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（52–58 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」，下署《左传·定公十年》；右下角朱印「夹谷」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (52–58 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」 signed 《左传·定公十年》; vermilion seal 「夹谷」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、众人呐喊、战后余风、宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲、战鼓、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, roaring crowd, lingering wind after battle, palace hall reverb; SFX: rustling silk, war drums, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「夹谷之会」、副题「孔子相礼」、朱印「夹谷」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」——《左传·定公十年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

narration: 鲁定公十年夏，鲁君与齐侯在夹谷会盟。孔子以司寇的身份担任相礼。
齐国大夫犁弥对齐侯说：孔丘懂礼而没有勇气，若让莱人带兵劫持鲁侯，一定能得逞。
会上，莱人持兵涌上坛来。孔子护着鲁君后退，命鲁国的士兵上前。
他说：两国国君和好，却让东夷的俘虏拿着兵器来扰乱，这不是齐君号令诸侯的做法。
齐侯听了——
齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。
裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】春秋 · 夹谷之会（孔子相礼）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 58 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：春秋 · 鲁定公十年，齐景公四十八年（前 500 年夏）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。

人物：
- 孔丘（鲁·鲁司寇，相礼）：深衣、皮弁；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；以礼却莱人之兵，使齐归侵地
- 鲁定公（鲁·鲁君）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；会齐侯于夹谷
- 齐景公（齐·齐君）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；欲以莱人劫鲁侯，闻孔子之言而辟之
- 犁弥（齐·齐大夫）：深衣、皮弁；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；献计以莱人劫鲁侯

分镜：
镜头 1（0–9 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：旌旗｜动作：夹谷的山间，两国的坛场相对而设｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「夹谷之会」竖排书法与朱印「夹谷」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「鲁定公十年夏，鲁君与齐侯在夹谷会盟。孔子以司寇的身份担任相礼。」
镜头 2（9–19 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：孔丘、鲁定公、旌旗｜动作：孔子立在鲁君身侧，整了整衣冠｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐国大夫犁弥对齐侯说：孔丘懂礼而没有勇气，若让莱人带兵劫持鲁侯，一定能得逞。」
镜头 3（19–27 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：犁弥、众人、长枪｜动作：鼓声里，一群莱人持兵冲上坛来｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：引文「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「会上，莱人持兵涌上坛来。孔子护着鲁君后退，命鲁国的士兵上前。」
镜头 4（27–37 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：孔丘；飞白题字「裔不谋夏」｜动作：孔子护着鲁君后退，厉声呵斥｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他说：两国国君和好，却让东夷的俘虏拿着兵器来扰乱，这不是齐君号令诸侯的做法。」
镜头 5（37–43 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：地图卷、归田；主体：齐景公｜动作：齐国归还了郓、讙、龟阴之田｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐侯听了——」
镜头 6（43–52 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：齐景公｜动作：正史结局：齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。」
镜头 7（52–58 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」，下署《左传·定公十年》；右下角朱印「夹谷」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、众人呐喊、战后余风、宫殿回响；音效：衣袂摩挲、战鼓、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「夹谷之会」、副题「孔子相礼」、朱印「夹谷」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」——《左传·定公十年》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · The Meeting at Jiagu: Confucius Leads the Rites (「夹谷之会」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 58 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 500 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Kong Qiu (孔丘) — scholar, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Lu Dinggong (鲁定公) — ruler, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Qi Jinggong (齐景公) — ruler, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Mi (犁弥) — minister, Qi; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: banners | Action: In the hills of Jiagu two altars face each other | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「夹谷之会」 with vermilion seal 「夹谷」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「鲁定公十年夏，鲁君与齐侯在夹谷会盟。孔子以司寇的身份担任相礼。」
Shot 2 (9–19 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Kong Qiu, Lu Dinggong, banners | Action: Confucius stands beside the Duke of Lu and straightens his robes | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐国大夫犁弥对齐侯说：孔丘懂礼而没有勇气，若让莱人带兵劫持鲁侯，一定能得逞。」
Shot 3 (19–27 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Li Mi, crowd, spear | Action: To the drums, Lai men rush the altar with weapons | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「会上，莱人持兵涌上坛来。孔子护着鲁君后退，命鲁国的士兵上前。」
Shot 4 (27–37 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Kong Qiu; dry-brush calligraphy 「裔不谋夏」 | Action: Confucius shields the duke and rebukes them sternly | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他说：两国国君和好，却让东夷的俘虏拿着兵器来扰乱，这不是齐君号令诸侯的做法。」
Shot 5 (37–43 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: map scroll, 归田; subject: Qi Jinggong | Action: Qi returns the lands of Yun, Huan and Guiyin | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐侯听了——」
Shot 6 (43–52 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Qi Jinggong | Action: Canonical outcome: The Qi ruler backs down; an armed ambush is defused by Confucius through ritual alone. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「齐侯遽辟之。盟后，齐人来归郓、讙、龟阴之田。一场兵劫，被孔子用礼化解了。」
Shot 7 (52–58 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」 signed 《左传·定公十年》; vermilion seal 「夹谷」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, roaring crowd, lingering wind after battle, palace hall reverb; SFX: rustling silk, war drums, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「夹谷之会」, subtitle 「孔子相礼」 and vermilion seal 「夹谷」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「裔不谋夏，夷不乱华。」 — 《左传·定公十年》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.chunqiu.laozi.title: 紫气东来
strings.scene.chunqiu.laozi.subtitle: 老子出关
strings.vo.01: 老子是楚国苦县人，姓李名耳，字聃，在东周做守藏室的史官，掌管王室的典籍。
strings.vo.02: 孔子到洛邑问礼于他。老子告诉他：良贾深藏若虚，君子盛德，容貌若愚。去掉你的骄气和多欲吧。
strings.vo.03: 孔子回去对弟子说：鸟我知道能飞，鱼我知道能游，兽我知道能走。至于龙，我不知道它怎样乘风云上天。我今天见到的老子，大概就是龙吧。
strings.vo.04: 老子在周住了很久，见周室衰微，于是西去。到了关口，关令尹喜说：您要隐居了，请勉强为我写一部书吧。
strings.scene.chunqiu.laozi.fork.prompt: 紫气东来——依《史记》直书，还是听神仙传说《列仙传》？
strings.anchor.chuguan: 老子著书上下篇而去，莫知其所终
strings.scene.chunqiu.laozi.canon.intro: 老子出关的年月，司马迁已经说不清。他只写下：著书上下篇，言道德之意五千余言而去。
strings.scene.chunqiu.laozi.end.canon: 老子写完上下两篇，言道德之意五千余言，然后离去，没有人知道他的终了。司马迁又录了老莱子、太史儋两说，说“世莫知其然否”。
strings.scene.chunqiu.laozi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取旧题刘向《列仙传》所载：关令尹喜望见紫气自东而来，知有圣人将至，果然迎来了老子，后来随他同游流沙之西。紫气东来之说出于神仙家，史书不载。
strings.scene.chunqiu.laozi.legend.intro: 列仙传里说，尹喜在关楼上望见一道紫气，从东方缓缓而来。
strings.scene.chunqiu.laozi.end.legend: 神仙家说尹喜随老子西游，二人俱入流沙，不知所终。“紫气东来”从此成了吉祥话，贴在许多人家的门楣上。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 老子是楚国苦县人，姓李名耳，字聃，在东周做守藏室的史官，掌管王室的典籍。
孔子到洛邑问礼于他。老子告诉他：良贾深藏若虚，君子盛德，容貌若愚。去掉你的骄气和多欲吧。
孔子回去对弟子说：鸟我知道能飞，鱼我知道能游，兽我知道能走。至于龙，我不知道它怎样乘风云上天。我今天见到的老子，大概就是龙吧。
老子在周住了很久，见周室衰微，于是西去。到了关口，关令尹喜说：您要隐居了，请勉强为我写一部书吧。
老子于是写下——
老子写完上下两篇，言道德之意五千余言，然后离去，没有人知道他的终了。司马迁又录了老莱子、太史儋两说，说“世莫知其然否”。
子将隐矣，强为我著书。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】春秋 · 紫气东来（老子出关）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 73 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

时代与场景：春秋 · 东周敬王时（约数）（约春秋末年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。

- 老子（周·周守藏室之史，李耳）：深衣、皮弁；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；见周之衰，西去出关，著书五千余言

镜头 4（35–47 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：关门；主体：尹喜、老子、盾墙｜动作：关令拦住他：先生要隐去了，请为我写下一部书｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：高处疾风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「老子在周住了很久，见周室衰微，于是西去。到了关口，关令尹喜说：您要隐居了，请勉强为我写一部书吧。」
镜头 5（47–53 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：关门、书写；主体：老子；飞白题字「五千言」｜动作：竹简上落下第一行字：道可道，非常道｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「老子于是写下——」
镜头 6（53–67 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：老子｜动作：正史结局：老子写完上下两篇，言道德之意五千余言，然后离去，没有人知道他的终了。司马迁又录了老莱子、太史儋两说，说“世莫知其然否”。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「老子写完上下两篇，言道德之意五千余言，然后离去，没有人知道他的终了。司马迁又录了老莱子、太史儋两说，说“世莫知其然否”。」
镜头 7（67–73 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「子将隐矣，强为我著书。」，下署《史记·老子韩非列传》；右下角朱印「道德五千言」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「子将隐矣，强为我著书。」

声音：背景乐：洞箫，幽咽悠长，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、琴室、低风、高处疾风、战后余风；音效：竹简翻动、衣袂摩挲、牛群、脚步声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：生成画面里不出现任何文字（含印章字，实测会出乱码），以下全部后期叠加：片头右上竖排书法片名「紫气东来」、副题「老子出关」、朱印「道德五千言」；旁白字幕为简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体；引文「子将隐矣，强为我著书。」——《史记·老子韩非列传》，竖排楷书；叠加文字必须与原文一字不差

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，全彩，多色，粉彩，马卡龙色，Q 版，萌系，大头娃娃，精细繁复纹理，大量渐变的 CG 质感，金色高光，蒸汽朋克机械，细密界画线条，细密皴纹，复杂五官，日本刀（武士刀），人物融化变形，墨迹倒流，血液倒流，卷轴融化，画面中途新增物体，构图漂移，画面内文字与印章字，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · Purple Air from the East: Laozi Leaves Through the Pass (「紫气东来」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 73 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), c. 500 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Lao Zi (老子) — scholar, Zhou; shenyi robes and leather caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yin Xi (尹喜) — commoner, Zhou; shenyi robes and leather caps; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Kong Zi (孔子) — scholar, Lu; shenyi robes and leather caps; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, 书写, palace eaves; subject: Lao Zi | Action: In the royal archive at Luoyi, bamboo slips are stacked to the roof beams | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「紫气东来」 with vermilion seal 「道德五千言」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「老子是楚国苦县人，姓李名耳，字聃，在东周做守藏室的史官，掌管王室的典籍。」
Shot 2 (9–20 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Kong Zi, Lao Zi | Action: A middle-aged visitor from Lu respectfully asks about the rites; the old man says only a few words | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: guqin room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔子到洛邑问礼于他。老子告诉他：良贾深藏若虚，君子盛德，容貌若愚。去掉你的骄气和多欲吧。」
Shot 3 (20–35 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: Lao Zi | Action: Years later the old man rides a black ox slowly toward the western pass | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: cattle | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「子将隐矣，强为我著书。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔子回去对弟子说：鸟我知道能飞，鱼我知道能游，兽我知道能走。至于龙，我不知道它怎样乘风云上天。我今天见到的老子，大概就是龙吧。」
Shot 4 (35–47 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Yin Xi, Lao Zi, shield wall | Action: The pass keeper stops him: Master, you are going into hiding, write a book for me first | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: high wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「老子在周住了很久，见周室衰微，于是西去。到了关口，关令尹喜说：您要隐居了，请勉强为我写一部书吧。」
Shot 5 (47–53 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: gate, 书写; subject: Lao Zi; dry-brush calligraphy 「五千言」 | Action: The first line is brushed onto the slips: "The Way that can be spoken is not the constant Way." | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「老子于是写下——」
Shot 6 (53–67 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Lao Zi | Action: Canonical outcome: Laozi finishes two books, some five thousand words on the Way and Virtue, then leaves, and no one knows where he ends. Sima Qian records two other candidates and admits no one can say which is true. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「老子写完上下两篇，言道德之意五千余言，然后离去，没有人知道他的终了。司马迁又录了老莱子、太史儋两说，说“世莫知其然否”。」
Shot 7 (67–73 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「子将隐矣，强为我著书。」 signed 《史记·老子韩非列传》; vermilion seal 「道德五千言」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「子将隐矣，强为我著书。」

Sound: Music: xiao flute, plaintive and long, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: quiet room tone, guqin room tone, low wind, high wind, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, rustling silk, cattle, footsteps; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: No text of any kind inside the generated frames (seal characters come out garbled in tests); add everything in post: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「紫气东来」, subtitle 「老子出关」 and vermilion seal 「道德五千言」 at upper right; Simplified Chinese subtitles, bottom centre; quotation 「子将隐矣，强为我著书。」 — 《史记·老子韩非列传》, vertical kaishu; overlaid text must match the source exactly

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, dense cun texture strokes, detailed faces, Japanese katana, melting or morphing figures, ink or blood flowing backwards, melting scrolls, objects appearing mid-shot, drifting composition, any text or seal characters inside the frame, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.chunqiu.wuyue.title: 卧薪尝胆
strings.scene.chunqiu.wuyue.subtitle: 吴越争霸
strings.vo.01: 吴王夫差败越于夫椒。越王勾践以甲兵五千人栖于会稽。
strings.vo.02: 大夫文种卑辞厚礼，向吴请和。伍子胥谏，夫差不听，许之。
strings.vo.03: 勾践返国，置胆于坐，坐卧即仰胆，饮食亦尝胆。
strings.vo.04: 他身自耕作，夫人自织，十年生聚，十年教训。
strings.vo.05: 吴王北上争霸之时，越师渡江——
strings.scene.chunqiu.wuyue.fork.prompt: 卧薪尝胆——依《史记》直书，还是听野史「西施与五湖」？
strings.scene.chunqiu.wuyue.canon.intro: 夫椒一战，越军大败。勾践带着残兵五千退保会稽山，吴军围了上来。
strings.scene.chunqiu.wuyue.end.canon: 前 473 年，越灭吴，夫差自杀。范蠡辞官而去，文种后被赐死。
strings.scene.chunqiu.wuyue.legend.disclaimer: 以下是后世传说。西施之名不见于《左传》《史记》，故事出自《吴越春秋》《越绝书》等东汉以后的书。
strings.scene.chunqiu.wuyue.legend.intro: 传说越国献美女西施于吴，夫差沉迷宫中；吴亡之后，西施随范蠡泛舟五湖而去。“卧薪”二字也是宋代以后才与尝胆连用。
strings.scene.chunqiu.wuyue.end.legend: 小舟没入烟水。传说的终点与史实相同：吴已亡，范蠡已去。

画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。

第 1 行：1. 勾践（越王）（越·君主）；2. 夫差（吴王）（吴·君主）；3. 范蠡（越大夫）（越·文臣）。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 越王勾践三年至二十四年（前 494—前 473 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 494 BCE–473 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

characters.name: 勾践
characters.zh: 勾践（越·越王）：深衣、皮弁；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；会稽之败后尝胆自励，灭吴称霸
characters.en: Gou Jian (勾践) — ruler, Yue; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 吴王夫差败越于夫椒。越王勾践以甲兵五千人栖于会稽。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、草｜动作：太湖烟水，远山如眉｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜屏幕文字：片名「卧薪尝胆」竖排书法与朱印「会稽之耻」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「吴王夫差败越于夫椒。越王勾践以甲兵五千人栖于会稽。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, grass | Action: Mist over Lake Tai, hills like eyebrows | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「卧薪尝胆」 with vermilion seal 「会稽之耻」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「吴王夫差败越于夫椒。越王勾践以甲兵五千人栖于会稽。」

shots.vo: 大夫文种卑辞厚礼，向吴请和。伍子胥谏，夫差不听，许之。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–15 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：中景：舟；主体：勾践、火｜动作：夫椒一战，越王退守会稽｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：摇橹、兵刃相击｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「大夫文种卑辞厚礼，向吴请和。伍子胥谏，夫差不听，许之。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–15 s, 7 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: boat; subject: Gou Jian, fire (splashed ink) | Action: After the battle of Fujiao the king of Yue retreats to Kuaiji | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: oars, clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「大夫文种卑辞厚礼，向吴请和。伍子胥谏，夫差不听，许之。」

shots.vo: 勾践返国，置胆于坐，坐卧即仰胆，饮食亦尝胆。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（15–21 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：文种、夫差｜动作：会稽请成：文种卑辞｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「勾践返国，置胆于坐，坐卧即仰胆，饮食亦尝胆。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (15–21 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Wen Zhong, Fu Cha | Action: Suing for peace at Kuaiji: Wen Zhong's humble words | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「勾践返国，置胆于坐，坐卧即仰胆，饮食亦尝胆。」

shots.vo: 他身自耕作，夫人自织，十年生聚，十年教训。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（21–27 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：月；主体：勾践、大刀｜动作：置胆于坐，坐卧仰胆｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：滴水｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他身自耕作，夫人自织，十年生聚，十年教训。」

narration: 吴王夫差败越于夫椒。越王勾践以甲兵五千人栖于会稽。
大夫文种卑辞厚礼，向吴请和。伍子胥谏，夫差不听，许之。
勾践返国，置胆于坐，坐卧即仰胆，饮食亦尝胆。
他身自耕作，夫人自织，十年生聚，十年教训。
吴王北上争霸之时，越师渡江——
前 473 年，越灭吴，夫差自杀。范蠡辞官而去，文种后被赐死。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

生成方式：每个镜头先按本风格出一张静帧作首帧，再图生视频；动势克制，只做衣袖与旗角轻摆、云雾缓移、镜头缓推，保持构图稳定，不变形，不新增物体；打斗、刺杀等激烈动作用关键帧静帧加剪辑表现，不让模型生成连续搏斗；运镜指令仅作参考。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE) · Sleeping on Brushwood, Tasting Gall: Wu and Yue (「卧薪尝胆」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 47 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Workflow: for each shot first render a still in this style as the first frame, then run image-to-video; keep motion restrained — sleeves and banner tips fluttering, cloud and mist drifting, a slow camera push; keep the composition stable, no morphing, no new objects; show fights and assassinations as keyframe stills plus editing rather than generated continuous combat; camera directions are a guide only.

Setting: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 494 BCE–473 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

Characters:
- Gou Jian (勾践) — ruler, Yue; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Fu Cha (夫差) — ruler, Wu; shenyi robes and leather caps; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wen Zhong (文种) — minister, Yue; shenyi robes and leather caps; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.title: 陈蔡绝粮
strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.subtitle: 孔子周游
strings.vo.01: 前 489 年，孔子周游列国已经多年，客居在陈蔡之间。楚国派人来聘请他，陈蔡的大夫怕孔子为楚所用，派人把他围在野外。
strings.vo.02: 粮食断了七天，跟随的弟子病倒了，躺在野地里起不了身。
strings.vo.03: 子路忍不住来问：君子也会穷困吗？孔子说：君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣。
strings.vo.04: 孔子依旧讲诵弦歌，琴声不绝。他把子路、子贡和颜回分别叫来，问：《诗》说“匪兕匪虎，率彼旷野”，难道是我的道不对吗？我为什么落到这一步？
strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.quote: 君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣。
strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.fork.prompt: 陈蔡绝粮——依《史记》直书，还是听寓言《庄子》？
strings.anchor.zhoyou: 孔子去鲁周游列国，居陈蔡之间
strings.anchor.chuyingzhi: 楚昭王兴师迎孔子，然后得免
strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.canon.intro: 周游列国的第十个年头，孔子一行在陈蔡之间的荒野里断粮七天。他问三个弟子同一个问题。
strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.end.canon: 孔子听了颜回的话，笑着说：颜家的孩子，假使你有很多钱，我就给你当管家。子贡到了楚国，楚昭王派兵迎接孔子，一行人才脱离困境。
strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《庄子·让王》对陈蔡之厄的另一种讲法：孔子在困境中依旧弦歌，子路、子贡在门外议论，孔子说“内省而不穷于道”。庄子书多寓言，所记对答与《史记》不同。
strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.legend.intro: 庄子讲的陈蔡之厄里，颜回在门外择菜，子路和子贡在一旁发牢骚。
strings.scene.chunqiu.chencai.end.legend: 庄子说孔子推琴而叹，子路扢然执干而舞。古时得道的人，穷也乐，通也乐。故事的结尾与史书不同，突围的事一字未提。

版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 水流笔迹。
第 2 行：4. 墨滴下坠；5. 风雪飞白；6. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 春秋 · 鲁哀公六年（前 489 年）。诸侯宫室、会盟高台、战车阵、城郭。
setting.en: Spring and Autumn period (770–476 BCE), 489 BCE — feudal palaces, covenant platforms, chariot formations, walled cities.

shots.vo: 前 489 年，孔子周游列国已经多年，客居在陈蔡之间。楚国派人来聘请他，陈蔡的大夫怕孔子为楚所用，派人把他围在野外。

shots.en: Shot 2 (14–22 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Zi Lu, crowd | Action: On the seventh day the disciples lie in the grass too weak to rise | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: cough | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「粮食断了七天，跟随的弟子病倒了，躺在野地里起不了身。」

shots.vo: 子路忍不住来问：君子也会穷困吗？孔子说：君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣。

shots.vo: 孔子依旧讲诵弦歌，琴声不绝。他把子路、子贡和颜回分别叫来，问：《诗》说“匪兕匪虎，率彼旷野”，难道是我的道不对吗？我为什么落到这一步？

shots.en: Shot 4 (30–45 s, 15 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Kong Zi | Action: Beside the cart the master plays the qin, and the music does not stop | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: guqin room tone; SFX: single guqin pluck | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔子依旧讲诵弦歌，琴声不绝。他把子路、子贡和颜回分别叫来，问：《诗》说“匪兕匪虎，率彼旷野”，难道是我的道不对吗？我为什么落到这一步？」

shots.vo: 轮到颜回，他说——
